design.z_ref: 2000..Y-1 recomputed per fold (never includes test year)
design.grade_head: global in every arm (only success/pick heads vary)

arms.baseline: global members + global Platt; global pick regressors (production recipe)
arms.group_platt: global members; per-group Platt on Y-1 cal rows (fallback global)
arms.group_heads: per-group success + pick members; pooled Platt over Y-1 cal rows scored by group models
arms.group_heads_success_only: group success head + baseline pick head (derived, no extra fit)
arms.group_heads_pick_only: baseline success head + group pick head (derived, no extra fit)

design.leakage_guarantee: per fold: train years < Y-1, cal == Y-1, z-ref < Y (asserted); group membership is a position flag (an X feature, never an outcome); MIN_TRAIN_ROWS / MIN_CAL_ROWS fixed a priori; X == tm.SUCCESS_FEATURES asserted disjoint from tm.FORBIDDEN_FEATURES; no tuning performed.
design.adoption_bar: target metric: >=4/6 fold wins AND mean delta > baseline fold-std/2; other served metrics: mean delta within noise band
